metadata.title: Waggle — The AI workspace that remembers
metadata.description: Waggle is a local-first AI workspace with persistent memory. Your projects, decisions, and context compound across every model — Claude, GPT, Gemini, or a local model — and never leave your machine.

hero.subhead: Waggle keeps a real memory of you and your work — on your machine, under your control. Every session starts where the last one ended, whichever model you run.

hero_visual.aria_label: Diagram of Waggle's local memory serving four AI models

problem.headline: Every AI session starts from zero.

reintroduce.title: You re-introduce yourself
reintroduce.body: The client, the voice, the constraints, the stack — explained again, to the same tool, for the hundredth time.

tabs.title: Context dies in tabs
tabs.body: The decision lives in one chat, the draft in another, the reasoning in neither. Nothing connects.

compound.title: Nothing compounds
compound.body: A year of AI conversations — and your assistant knows you no better than it did on day one.

problem.turn: Waggle takes the opposite bet: your context is an asset. Capture it once, own it locally, and let every session build on the last.

how_it_works.headline: Three steps to an AI that knows your work.

step_01.title: Bring your history
step_01.body: Import your ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini conversations — plus PDFs, notes, and documents. Harvest turns them into structured memory, entirely on your machine.

step_02.title: Work in workspaces
step_02.body: Chat, tasks, and files in one place, with specialist personas for the way you work — and any model underneath: Claude, GPT, Gemini, or a local model.

step_03.title: Let it compound
step_03.body: Every session updates a knowledge graph of your projects, people, and decisions. Tomorrow starts where today ended — nothing re-explained, nothing lost.

memory.headline: A real memory substrate, not a longer prompt.
memory.body: Conversations and files become frames in a local SQLite store. Frames index into hybrid search — vector and keyword — and a knowledge graph links the people, projects, and decisions inside them. Identity and awareness layers track who you are and what you're working on, so recall is precise, explainable, and fast.

proof.headline: State of the art on LoCoMo — on the previous leader's own ruler.
proof.body: LoCoMo is the standard benchmark for long-term conversational memory. Waggle's open-source memory substrate scores 86.49% — measured under the previous leader's exact protocol and judge, and ahead in or tied on every question category. The full harness ships in the repo: run it yourself, offline.
proof.footnote: N=1,540 · GPT-4.1-mini as answerer and judge (the prior leader's published protocol) · +4.54 points, z=4.64 · reproducible offline
proof.chart_aria: Bar chart comparing LoCoMo scores: Waggle 86.49%, Memori 81.95%, Mem0 73.96%

features.headline: A complete workspace, not another chat window.

personas.title: 22 specialist personas
personas.body: From planner and verifier to analyst and coder — each with its own tools, guardrails, and a hard boundary on what it won't do.

models.title: Any model underneath
models.body: Thirteen provider families under one router — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Qwen, Grok, DeepSeek, Mistral, and more, with your own keys. Switch mid-project; the memory stays.

harvest.title: Harvest your history
harvest.body: Import ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity exports — plus PDF, Markdown, and URLs — into structured, searchable memory.

loops.title: Loops & approvals
loops.body: Recurring agent runs that report before they act. Anything consequential waits in an approval queue for your sign-off.

skills.title: Skills & connectors
skills.body: Installable skills with integrity auditing, connectors to your tools, and a built-in catalog of 149 MCP servers.

memory_center.title: Memory Center
memory_center.body: See the original source behind every memory, trace where an answer came from, and erase for real — erasure survives re-import.

sovereignty.headline: Local-first isn't a feature flag. It's the architecture.

device.title: On-device by default
device.body: Your memory is a SQLite file on your machine — not a row in someone else's cloud.

egress.title: Only what you send leaves
egress.body: Model calls go to the providers you configure, with your keys, held in a local vault.

erasure.title: Erasure that holds
erasure.body: Delete a source and it stays deleted — with provenance and an audit trail, built for the EU AI Act era.

injection.title: Screened inputs
injection.body: External content is scanned for prompt injection before any agent acts on it.

personas_section.heading: Meet the hive.
personas_section.subtitle: 22 personas ship in the box — universal modes like planner, verifier, and researcher, plus workspace specialists from sales to legal. Each one knows its tools, and its limits.

open_source.headline: The memory layer is open. Take it.
open_source.body: hive-mind is Waggle's memory substrate — frames, hybrid search, knowledge graph — published with the full LoCoMo benchmark harness. Use it in your own agents, audit every query, or reproduce our numbers offline.

pricing.headline: Memory is free forever. Pay when you scale.
pricing.subhead: Every install starts with 15 days of everything unlocked — no credit card. After that, the free tier keeps your memory, import, and agents for good.
